environment.description: ECS Fargate task deployed in an isolated private subnet (no NAT gateway, no internet gateway). All service communication occurs exclusively through com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0f4a8b2c1d3e5f6a7 interface endpoint with a restrictive endpoint policy scoped to the task execution role (arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/stream-proc-task-role). The VPC endpoint's security group (sg-09f8e7d6c5b4a3210) permits only TCP/9094 inbound from the task's security group. The task's own security group (sg-01a2b3c4d5e6f7890) has NO inbound rules and outbound restricted to the VPC CIDR (10.0.0.0/16) only. The subnet route table has only a local route (10.0.0.0/16 -> local) with no other entries. Container runs as non-root uid 10001 with readOnlyRootFilesystem=true and tmpfs mount at /tmp with size=64M,noexec,nosuid,mode=1700 (sticky bit, owner-only). Task definition specifies linuxParameters.initProcessEnabled=true with drop ALL capabilities.
